packages.title: Stremio Origin
packages.shortDescription: Native app for Stremio addons on LG webOS TVs. Unofficial.

manifest.title: Stremio Origin
manifest.appDescription: Your own Stremio account and addons on your LG TV, in English or Arabic: artwork and full-screen trailers, the best stream in one press, styled subtitles, clean search. Unofficial.
notes: Everything in Arabic: Home, the spotlight, Discover, Similar, the Library and the screensaver: names, posters, logos and descriptions in Arabic or English, from TMDB.
Search in Arabic: Type a name in Arabic or English: suggestions and results come in your language.
Picks that fit: Watch something similar shows TMDB's recommendations for that very title.
Fixes install themselves: Small updates install quietly while the TV is left alone, so you always have the latest fixes.
